messages:
Alex Kim: bringing up candidate model llm-lite-quant-v2 for /text-gen. plan is canary 5% for 24h. need clear rollout gates + automatic fallback. who wants to draft the gate list?
Maria V: quick summary of local evals: perplexity control=12.5, candidate=12.8 (+2.4%). embed cosine sim drop avg=0.007, worst-case prompts 3/240. latency p99 +18ms. quantization: PTQ 8-bit per-channel, aten kernels; no kv-cache changes so far. seems close to targets but want tight canary gates for user-facing prompts.
Jules: proposed gates (short):
- perplexity_total <= baseline * 1.03
- critical_prompt_failures (hand-curated set) <= 5 in 24h
- embed_cosine_drop_avg <= 0.015 and worst_case_drop <= 0.03
- latency.p99 <= baseline + 30ms
Auto-fallback rules:
- immediate rollback if any gate is exceeded for continuous 5m OR
- if critical_prompt_failures > 10 in 1h then rollback and notify @oncall.
Neha: agree. add A/B measurement hooks: record BLEU/ROUGE/perplexity, hallucination heuristics (entity hallucination count), and a user-satisfaction proxy (suggestion_accept_rate). push all to experiments pipeline with per-model tagging.
Alex Kim: config snippet for ops team (yaml):
```
rollout:
  model: llm-lite-quant-v2
  route: /text-gen
  strategy: canary
  canary_percent: 5
  duration: 24h
  gates:
    - name: perplexity_gate
      threshold: baseline * 1.03
      window: 1h
    - name: critical_prompts_gate
      threshold: 5
      window: 24h
    - name: embed_drop_gate
      threshold: 0.015
      window: 1h
    - name: latency_p99_gate
      threshold: baseline + 30ms
      window: 5m
  auto_fallback:
    enabled: true
    conditions:
      - gate_exceeded_continuous: 5m
      - critical_failures_in_1h: 10
  logging: [ab_metrics, eval_suite, traces]
```
Jules: add alerting hooks for SLOs and a secondary health-check that samples top-traffic prompts. also one-shot canary test that runs the curated critical set every 15m.
deploy-bot: deploy started: llm-lite-quant-v2 -> canary (5%). deploy id dpl_2024_09_12_021
Maria V: kicked off smoke eval in staging: `/evals/run dpl_2024_09_12_021 --set=critical_prompts --n=2000`
eval-bot: smoke eval results: samples=2000, perplexity_ctrl=12.4, perplexity_cand=12.7, delta=+2.4%, critical_failures=1, embed_drop_avg=0.006, latency_p99_delta=+17ms.
Alex Kim: good initial smoke. start canary traffic 5% for 24h. set experiment id exp_2024_09_canary_01 and enable auto-fallback as configured. I will open a canary ticket and link dashboards. :thumbsup:
Neha: I'll wire the A/B metrics to the experiments dashboard and add the hallucination detector. will alert slack channel if anything crosses thresholds.
Jules: follow-up: let's plan a 50% staged ramp only after 24h and no gate breaches. if any gate trips, the auto-fallback should be atomic and trigger rollback + postmortem checklist.
Alex Kim: agreed. tagging @oncall for visibility. I'll update the runbook with the rollback checklist and add the critical prompt list to the ticket.
